scope: Unified modeling research on UniRank Taobao; DIN is an initial empirical reference; whole-model architecture exploration per GPU
research_objective: Explore and validate mechanism-distinct unified modeling of multi-field user/context/target features and multi-feedback behavior histories. Develop representations and information flow that jointly support sequence modeling, feature interaction and task prediction under the fixed data and compute protocol.

baseline_role.purpose: Initial empirical reference and calibration point for predictive quality, diagnostics and compute cost.
baseline_role.final_model_family: Open; selected from evidence and may be a completely different architecture.
baseline_role.later_comparisons: Use the initial reference and the closest successful architectural alternatives or controls as the research progresses.

new_run_authority: user: repeat Taobao research for12h, select by average AUC
research_startpoint: fresh DIN reference; no historical trial imported as a search incumbent
initial_knowledge: external method knowledge only; previous experimental trajectories and test outcomes not supplied
prior_test_use: The fixed official test split was evaluated in the previous campaign; any later reuse is supplementary.

selection_policy.missing_task: invalid; never average only the available tasks
selection_policy.regression_policy: Report each task's AUC and Logloss change against the reference and entry model; explain trade-offs in topic decisions. No undeclared per-task veto threshold.
selection_policy.test_policy: Selection uses validation only; freeze before a single held-out assessment. Historical completed test suites remain unchanged.
